title: PWS event message
description: Immediate event published on pws/{device_id}/event (QoS 1, not retained) when something happens that should not wait for the next telemetry cycle. Unknown keys are ignored by the server.

device_id.description: Publishing device. Optional; the contract example omits it and the topic already carries it.

type.description: Event type (v1 list). time_unsynced: clock lost trust, uplink of observations paused. sensor_lost / sensor_found: a selected station stopped or resumed being heard. update_failed: an update attempt failed (see the update message for detail). rollback: the bootloader returned to the previous version. sdr_missing: no radio detected. outbox_overflow: the outbox hit its cap and dropped data.

detail.description: Type specific detail, an object the contract leaves open. Suggested keys: 'key' (station key) for sensor_lost and sensor_found, 'error' for update_failed, 'dropped' for outbox_overflow. Empty object when there is nothing to add.
